info.title: LogicalModels Enumeration API
info.description: API endpoint providing an enumeration of all available Logical Model schemas

get.summary: Get enumeration of all Logical Model schemas
get.description: Returns a list of all available Logical Model schemas with metadata

schemas.title: Regulated Trade Item (DTH product catalogue handbook, Fig. 9)
schemas.description: A trade item as authorised in a jurisdiction, as drawn in Fig. 9 of the WHO Digital transformation handbook for health product catalogues (2025). One Trade Item has zero or more Regulated Trade Items. This IG's ProductAuthorization carries a related but different set of elements. Anchored to dth-pc glossary concept https://litlfred.github.io/dth-pc/v0/ns#glossary/dth-pc/regulated-trade-item.

schemas.title: Trade Item (DTH product catalogue handbook, Fig. 9)
schemas.description: A packaged, identified unit of a Generic Product as traded, as drawn in Fig. 9 of the WHO Digital transformation handbook for health product catalogues (2025). One Generic Product has zero or more Trade Items. Anchored to dth-pc glossary concept https://litlfred.github.io/dth-pc/v0/ns#glossary/dth-pc/trade-item.

schemas.title: Generic Product
schemas.description: In this handbook, the terms ‘generic product,’ ‘product,’ or ‘product information’ pertain to the general identifying details of a health product, excluding any manufacturer-specific information (WHO DTH Product Catalogue Handbook, p. 8; Ch 2, p. 28; Fig. 9, p. 29). Anchored to dth-pc glossary concept https://litlfred.github.io/dth-pc/v0/ns#glossary/dth-pc/generic-product.

schemas.title: Product
schemas.description: A Product represents a physical item or set of items which can be held in inventory, ordered, exchanged, dispensed or other utilized within the health system, clinical and supply chain workflows. Anchored to dth-pc Product Master Data (https://litlfred.github.io/dth-pc/v0/ns#glossary/dth-pc/product-master-data) and Generic Product (https://litlfred.github.io/dth-pc/v0/ns#glossary/dth-pc/generic-product).

schemas.title: Product Authorization
schemas.description: A record of authorization or compliance for one or more Products with a set of regulatory, policy, (pre-)qualification, or legal requirements. Anchored to dth-pc Regulated Trade Item (https://litlfred.github.io/dth-pc/v0/ns#glossary/dth-pc/regulated-trade-item).

schemas.title: Regulated Trade Item
schemas.description: A Regulated Trade Item represents an authorization of a Trade item within a given jurisdiction under a Product Authorization (WHO DTH Product Catalogue Handbook, Ch 2, p. 28; Fig. 9, p. 29). Anchored to dth-pc glossary concept https://litlfred.github.io/dth-pc/v0/ns#glossary/dth-pc/regulated-trade-item.

schemas.title: Trade Item
schemas.description: Trade items are manufacturer-specific branded health products that are identifiable and unique to a particular brand or manufacturer (WHO DTH Product Catalogue Handbook, Ch 2, p. 28; Fig. 9, p. 29). Models the WHO Product Catalogue narrow sense of Trade Item (broadMatch GS1 Trade Item per litlfred/smart-ra#142). Anchored to dth-pc glossary concept https://litlfred.github.io/dth-pc/v0/ns#glossary/dth-pc/trade-item.

EnumerationResponse.title: Logical Model Enumeration Schema
EnumerationResponse.description: JSON Schema defining the structure of the Logical Model enumeration endpoint response

url.description: Relative URL to the schema file

logicalModelUrl.description: FHIR canonical URL of the Logical Model

propertyCount.description: Number of properties in the Logical Model
